serverMapping.note: Model ID is resolved from the served source mapping; the voice protocol does not echo a model ID at runtime.

instrumentation.serverClock: Worker Date.now(), copied verbatim from turn_metrics

isolation.mechanism: localStorage['voice-agent-session-id'] = runId before app load; one browser context, one page

limits: Text path only. A voice call cannot start while STT startup fails, so no TTS audio is produced for these turns.
t_first_visible_text is DOM text plus two animation frames; compositor paint is not observable from JS.
Server timings use the Worker clock and are reported separately, never combined with client timings.
p95 at n=20 is close to the maximum; the report states the estimator explicitly.
The dev server on :5173 is shared with other sessions; only the Durable Object instance is isolated.
